nodes.label: Backtracking with Branch-and-Bound Pruning
nodes.rationale: Uses backtracking with branch-and-bound pruning to find optimal meld allocation. Maximizes total cards in completed melds while resolving joker card conflicts through overlap checking.

nodes.label: Contested Cards Resolution Logic
nodes.rationale: Cards in unallocated melds where ALL cards are unused are 'contested' and excluded from near-meld detection. If some cards were taken by winning allocation, remaining cards are free for near-meld detection.

nodes.label: Heuristic Card Scoring Formula
nodes.rationale: Card Score = (comboPotential × 40) + (completionChance × 30) + (flexibility × 20) - (deadRisk × 25) - (highPointPenalty × 10). Balances offensive potential against defensive risk.

nodes.label: Joker Mechanism (Rank-Based Wildcard)
nodes.rationale: Joker is NOT a separate card. Determined at game start: one card drawn blindly reveals its rank, all 4 cards of that rank become wildcards. Indicator card is placed separately, owned by no one.

nodes.label: Strategic Explainability Principle
nodes.rationale: Product strength is 'strategic explainability' not AI hype. Prioritize explainable recommendations, deterministic logic, fast response, clean architecture.

nodes.label: Recommendation Priority Order
nodes.rationale: Priority: 1) Preserve completed melds, 2) Preserve high-probability near melds, 3) Remove dead high cards, 4) Remove low synergy cards, 5) Minimize future penalty.

nodes.label: Pure Client-Side SPA Architecture
nodes.rationale: All engine logic runs client-side as pure TypeScript functions. No external AI APIs required. Offline-capable logic preferred. Engine must be framework-independent.

nodes.label: Discard Pickup Net Score Formula
nodes.rationale: netScore = meldValue - costOfExtras. meldValue = cards_in_meld × 10. costOfExtras = (cardsTaken - 1) × 5. worthIt = netScore > drawDeckScore. drawDeckScore = avg completionProbability of nearMelds × 30.

nodes.label: Card Mutual Exclusion Invariant
nodes.rationale: A card cannot exist in multiple zones simultaneously (hand, discardPile, visibleMelds, jokerIndicator). isCardUsed checks all zones before any add operation to enforce this invariant.
